name: stri_read_lines
title: Read a Text File as Lines

origin.description: Read a file, decode it, and split it into lines.

arguments.name: con
arguments.text: A path or a binary connection.

arguments.name: encoding
arguments.text: The input encoding. NULL or '' uses the default converter.

origin.details: Line breaks follow stri_split_lines1. A trailing break does not add an extra empty line. encoding auto is an error.
origin.value: A character vector, one string per line.
origin.example:
path <- tempfile(); writeBin(charToRaw("a
b

"), path); cat(paste0("stri_read_lines(path) returns ", length(stri_read_lines(path)), " lines.
"))

translation.description: Read a file, decode it, and split it into lines.

arguments.name: encoding
arguments.text: The input encoding. None or '' uses UTF-8.

translation.details: Breaks are CR, LF, CRLF, VT, FF, NEL, LS, and PS. A trailing break does not add an extra empty line. The encoding auto is an error.
translation.example:
import tempfile
path = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False).name
Path(path).write_bytes(b"a\nb\n\n")
print(f"stri_read_lines(path) returns {len(stri_read_lines(path))} lines.")
